bio: This vineyard devoted to Corton-Charlemagne is home to a fine dining establishment, whose peaceful, contemporary interior provides the perfect foil to sample dishes that waver between France and Japan and are dotted with surprising and inspired combinations. Out-of-the-ordinary, highly personal creations, based on the produce of the restaurant’s garden (and hives) and from local, stringently selected suppliers. All of which is flanked by an appropriately awesome wine list....
